description: Power Automate Process Mining Variant DNA allows users to easily visualize their processes in a way that displays the events that belong to each variant using blocks that resemble DNA. It allows you to get an overview of all the process variants found in the business process, a glimpse of process characteristics and variations of the process, how standardized the process is and it allows you to identify differences or repeated patterns in your business process.
keywords: Power Automate Process Mining - Variant DNA Visual
